found.truth_sql: SELECT count() AS o0 FROM (SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'Pacific/Apia')) AS c0, uniqExactIf(u.id, u.is_vip) AS c1 FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE (o.status = 'completed') GROUP BY c0) WHERE (toDateTime(toStartOfYear(toDateTime64(c0, 3, 'Pacific/Apia')), 'Pacific/Apia') >= toDateTime(toStartOfYear(toDateTime64('2025-04-01', 3, 'Pacific/Apia')), 'Pacific/Apia') AND toDateTime(toStartOfYear(toDateTime64(c0, 3, 'Pacific/Apia')), 'Pacific/Apia') <= toDateTime(toStartOfYear(toDateTime64('2025-06-15', 3, 'Pacific/Apia')), 'Pacific/Apia')) SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
